meta.tech_stack: React, Tailwind CSS, Shadcn/UI, Lucide React

hero_countdown.description: Massive central timer. Minimalist. No boxes.
hero_countdown.styles: flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-[40vh] md:min-h-[50vh]

prayer_card.description: Clean cards for each prayer time. Highlight the current/next one.
prayer_card.base_style: flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-6 rounded-2xl bg-card border border-border/50 transition-all duration-300 hover:border-primary/50 hover:shadow-lg

progress_bar.description: Slim, top-aligned or subtle background bar indicating Ramadan progress.

city_selector.description: Minimal dropdown using Shadcn Select. Transparent background.
city_selector.trigger_style: bg-transparent border-none text-xl md:text-2xl font-light hover:bg-transparent hover:text-primary focus:ring-0 focus:ring-offset-0 px-0 shadow-none gap-2

images.background_pattern: No images. Use subtle CSS radial gradients for 'Glow' effects.

universal_guidelines.spacing_rule: Use 2x padding than normal. White space is luxury.
universal_guidelines.border_radius: Use 'rounded-3xl' for main containers, 'rounded-2xl' for cards.
universal_guidelines.interaction: Add 'active:scale-95' to all buttons. Add 'hover:text-primary' to interactive text.
universal_guidelines.accessibility: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA. Use 'text-foreground' on 'bg-background'.
universal_guidelines.language: All text MUST be in Turkish. Default city: Erzincan.
universal_guidelines.pwa: Ensure viewport meta tag prevents zooming on inputs. Add manifest link.
universal_guidelines.react_structure: Use functional components with hooks. Keep imports clean.
universal_guidelines.animation: Use 'tailwindcss-animate' utilities (animate-in, fade-in, slide-in-from-bottom) for entrance effects.
universal_guidelines.state_management: Use React Context or simple useState for Prayer Times data to avoid prop drilling.

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Update /app/frontend/src/index.css with the provided CSS variables (HSL values).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Install 'lucide-react' and 'date-fns' (if needed) for time calculation.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Build the 'CitySelector' component using Shadcn Select.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_6: Construct the main layout: Header (City + Theme), Hero (Countdown), Grid (Prayer Times), Footer (Info).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_7: Implement Geolocation and LocalStorage for city preference.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_8: Ensure PWA manifest is created in /app/frontend/public/manifest.json.
instructions_to_main_agent.important_note: Do not use 'Inter'. Use 'Outfit' for headings. Use Turkish names for prayers: İmsak, Güneş, Öğle, İkindi, Akşam, Yatsı.
